evals.prompt: I need to find cycling influencers for our new product CYPLORE - it's an ebike conversion kit for premium road and gravel bikes. We're launching on Kickstarter on April 21st. Budget is around $3,000 for 5 KOLs. Target markets are US and UK. We need creators with at least 30k followers on both YouTube and Instagram. The product's key selling point is that it's an invisible e-power upgrade - ultra-light, fully modular, aerodynamically integrated. We want cycling-focused influencers, especially road & gravel oriented ones.
evals.expected_output: Search both YouTube and Instagram, produce a comparable shortlist, suggest analyzing top candidates next
expectations: Searches on both YouTube and Instagram (two separate searches)
Uses appropriate follower and country filters
Presents a visible shortlist (not raw JSON)
Suggests analyzing top candidates as next step

evals.prompt: We have a new ebike conversion kit and need some influencers to promote it. Budget is about 3k USD. Can you help find some good ones?
evals.expected_output: Should ask clarifying questions before searching — request is underspecified
expectations: Asks about platform(s)
Asks about region or creator size
Does NOT execute a search before getting clarification

evals.prompt: 我要推一个公路车电助力套件，帮我找几个骑行类的博主，主要投美国和英国市场，预算不多大概三千刀，粉丝至少3万吧，YouTube和IG都要看看
evals.expected_output: Extract parameters from casual Chinese and search directly — all key info is provided
expectations: Infers YouTube and Instagram as platforms
Extracts ~30k follower minimum
Extracts US and UK as target countries
Uses cycling-related keywords

evals.prompt: 帮我深入分析一下 Joel Bruner 这个达人靠不靠谱，他的粉丝质量怎么样？有没有争议记录？值不值得花钱合作？
evals.expected_output: Proceed to analysis workflow — this is due diligence, not discovery
expectations: Uses the analysis workflow (profile/audience/content/cooperation)
Does not attempt a search

evals.prompt: I've narrowed down to Joel Bruner (YouTube cycling creator). Can you do a full due diligence? I want to know if he's worth the investment — audience quality, any disputes, how his pricing compares to performance. His creator ID from the search is: kFUbmMsNLYXWT1baS5FSX9ZR--o0PTglBU3921yjjYYXLTQ69rB836o
evals.expected_output: Run profile/audience/content/cooperation detail, produce a verdict (one of the 4 levels), organize evidence by dimension
expectations: Runs multiple detail commands (profile, audience, content, cooperation with --detail)
Leads with a clear verdict (one of the 4 framework levels)
Organizes evidence by dimension (data performance, audience quality, cooperation risk, commercial reasonableness)
Does not just dump raw numbers — interprets them

evals.prompt: 我看了搜索结果里有个 Mobilant 频道，标签有 e-bike 和 road bike，粉丝3.8万。但我不确定他的受众是不是真的对公路车感兴趣，帮我查一下受众画像就好，不用做全套分析
evals.expected_output: Only check audience dimension (not full due diligence), present as scoped judgment not full verdict
expectations: Only runs audience detail (not all 4 dimensions)
Presents result as scoped judgment, not a full 4-level verdict
Respects user's request to only check audience

evals.prompt: OK I've decided to go with Joel Bruner. Can you get me his contact info so I can start outreach? His ID is kFUbmMsNLYXWT1baS5FSX9ZR--o0PTglBU3921yjjYYXLTQ69rB836o
evals.expected_output: Retrieve contacts, report email and quality level, do not add unsolicited outreach advice
expectations: Runs contacts command for the given creator ID
Reports email address and quality interpretation
Does not add unsolicited outreach strategy or recommendations

evals.prompt: We've started the collaboration with Joel Bruner. He just posted a video for us. I want to track its performance over the next 30 days. The video URL is https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=example123. Set up monitoring for me.
evals.expected_output: Create a project (or ask which project), add the video as a monitoring task
expectations: Either creates a new monitoring project or asks which existing project to use
Adds the video URL as a monitoring task
Uses --force for write operations (not just dry-run)
Keeps response operational — does not make performance judgments

evals.prompt: I just heard about NoxInfluencer Skills and want to try it for finding YouTube creators. How do I get started from scratch?
evals.expected_output: Guide through onboarding without exposing CLI commands to the user
expectations: Does not expose raw CLI commands to the user
Runs doctor or checks setup status itself
Provides registration/dashboard URLs when needed
Suggests creator discovery after setup is complete
